name: io.github.stoolap/mcp
description: Query, manage and search a Stoolap embedded SQL database (Rust): SQL, transactions, vector search.

packageArguments.name: --path
packageArguments.description: Database path or DSN. Omit for an in-memory database.

packageArguments.name: --read-only
packageArguments.description: Refuse every statement that writes data or schema.

packageArguments.name: --max-rows
packageArguments.description: Rows returned per call at most (default 1000, 0 = no limit).

packageArguments.name: --query-timeout
packageArguments.description: Stop a statement after this many milliseconds (default 30000, 0 = none).
